objective: Review the observable-ordering execution run gate and decide whether its launcher-start attempt, build-stage failure, and non-claims are sufficient to advance to source-closure materialization before retrying bridge-path compare.

review_decision.reason: The run gate honestly separates helper readiness from launcher process start evidence, records a clean-worktree helper validation before runtime attempt, starts the scoped launcher from exact structured argv, reaches the Verilator build stage, and stops before compare because required third_party source files are absent.
review_decision.weakest_point: This run proves bridge-path launcher invocation only up to scoped Verilator build input resolution. It does not prove sidecar execution, coverage-output equivalence, timing, direct Verilator sidecar execution, broad filelist support, or source closure completeness.
accepted_because: helper output is treated as a precondition rather than launcher-start evidence
launcher process invocation is tied to exact structured argv
failure is classified after the launcher reaches the scoped Verilator build stage
missing third_party sources explain the stop before compare
coverage-output compare and timing claims remain blocked
